items.instruction: Fetch, bring main level with origin/main and create a new branch from origin/main for this work; do all the work on that branch and never commit to main.
items.title: Fresh branch from origin/main

items.instruction: Update the feature's specification and statuses (requirements, tasks, decisions, findings) as you work, not only at the end, so they always match the code.
items.title: Keep the feature's records current

items.instruction: Update the status of the related GitHub issues as work moves, comment with what was done, and close an issue only when its work is merged.
items.title: Keep GitHub issues in step

items.instruction: Run the project's automated tests and the build, fix what fails, and show the result.
items.title: Run the automated tests

items.instruction: Commit all changes in sensible commits so the working tree is clean at the end, including leftovers of earlier work that belong to this change; ask me about files that do not.
items.title: Everything committed

items.instruction: Push the branch and open a pull request that describes the change and has a test plan.
items.title: Pull request

items.instruction: Wait for the pull request's CI checks, fix any failure, and do not finish with a red or pending check.
items.title: CI is green

items.instruction: Merge the pull request once the checks pass, and make sure main contains the work.
items.title: Merge the pull request

items.instruction: Bump the version according to the project's versioning rules before the final commit.
items.title: Bump the version

items.instruction: Build the release and deploy it the way this project does, then confirm that the deployed version is the new one.
items.title: Build and deploy

items.instruction: Open the running app in a MarkView browser tab, walk through the changed flow like a user, and report what you saw.
items.title: Check it in a MarkView browser tab

items.instruction: Give me a short checklist of what to try by hand and wait for my answer before closing the goal.
items.title: Manual test checklist for me
